parts.text: By reference to the photoelectric effect, explain what is meant by work function energy.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem:
In an experiment, electromagnetic radiation of frequency $f$ is incident on a metal surface.

The results in Fig. 10.1 show the variation with frequency $f$ of the maximum kinetic energy $E_{\text{MAX}}$ of electrons emitted from the surface.

Fig. 10.1
parts.text: Determine the work function energy in $\text{J}$ of the metal used in the experiment.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The work function energy in $\text{eV}$ for some metals is given in Table 10.1.
Table 10.1
| metal | work function/$\text{eV}$ |
| tungsten | 4.49 |

Determine the metal used in the experiment. Show your working.
